description: A 4-digit seven-segment display module driven by a TM1637 controller over a 2-wire interface.
how_to_use: CLK/DIO are a bit-banged, TM1637-proprietary protocol — it resembles I2C but isn't real I2C, and is confirmed NOT caught by this project's SDA/SCL-name protocol-bus guard. VCC/GND are power.

plain.what: A 4-digit number display (like a clock) that needs only two wires to control.
plain.how: VCC and GND for power, CLK and DIO to two Arduino pins, then use the TM1637 library to show numbers.
